build_merged_tree: git fetch origin <branch> <target>; merge origin/<branch> into a scratch worktree cut from the target tip fetched at gate start; cargo build --all-targets
focused_vs_full: A name-filter run only localizes a failure. The verdict rests on the whole cargo test run.
zero_match_check: cargo test <filter> -- --list must list the intended tests; cargo test no_such_test_at_all -- --list must list none
